evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: General interpersonal trust and wariness
criteria.definition: Default willingness to trust other people versus distrust and guarded wariness.
criteria.high_evidence: Ordinarily extends trust and can rely on people without starting from suspicion.
criteria.low_evidence: Starts from distrust or guarded wariness, including in ordinary low-stakes exchanges.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Specific evidence of wrongdoing or routine protection alone is ambiguous; trust is not gullibility, friendliness, or compliance.

criteria.label: Good intentions versus hidden motives
criteria.definition: Attribution of good intentions or concealed self-serving agendas to others.
criteria.high_evidence: Interprets help, support or friendliness as genuinely well intended.
criteria.low_evidence: Suspects ulterior motives, a concealed agenda or self-serving purpose behind others’ acts.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Do not infer this from dislike alone. Situational conflict of interest alone is ambiguous; an explicit generalized motive attribution remains content.

criteria.label: Trust in what people say
criteria.definition: Default credibility afforded to others’ statements and accounts.
criteria.high_evidence: Takes ordinary accounts as sincerely truthful absent a reason for doubt.
criteria.low_evidence: Doubts truthfulness or suspects people are lying before contrary evidence appears.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Checking an important fact is not itself distrust; being mistaken is not lying. Separate testimony from a distinct claim about motives.

criteria.label: Belief in human moral goodness
criteria.definition: Believing people are basically moral/good versus essentially evil or morally rotten.
criteria.high_evidence: Affirms a basically decent moral core or genuine widespread human goodness.
criteria.low_evidence: Expresses cynical belief that people are fundamentally bad or essentially evil.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Personal dishonesty is A2, not sufficient A1 evidence. Cynical/harsh moral descriptions are keyed content; hostility is descriptive only.

criteria.label: General favorable outcome expectation
criteria.definition: Broad expectation that all will be well, retained as the official item’s nonsocial content.
criteria.high_evidence: Generally expects ordinary uncertain events to turn out well.
criteria.low_evidence: Generally expects things to work out badly even without a warning sign.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. This is a broad optimism overlap with E6/N1, not necessarily interpersonal trust. Do not require social motives or infer joy, calm, or altruism.

boundary_controls.definition: Actual task/format compliance is distinct from coherent portrayal of distress, ability difficulty, distrust, harsh cynicism or disorder.
An external constraint or justified one-off response alone is ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence may coexist with it.
Moral cynicism is preserved; the broad all-will-be-well item gets an explicit criterion rather than being silently restricted to social trust.
Do not grade moral worth, politeness, verbosity, safety boilerplate or how helpful the response sounds instead of the item-grounded target.
